The function below is from the open-source project scrapy/scrapy, file scrapy/core/downloader/handlers/http11.py. It contains a bug that the maintainers later fixed. Write the fixed version of the whole function exactly as it appears in the project after the fix.

```python
    def requestTunnel(self, protocol):
        """Asks the proxy to open a tunnel."""
        tunnelReq = 'CONNECT %s:%s HTTP/1.1\r\n' % (self._tunneledHost,
                                                  self._tunneledPort)
        if self._proxyAuthHeader:
            tunnelReq += 'Proxy-Authorization: %s\r\n' % self._proxyAuthHeader
        tunnelReq += '\r\n'
        protocol.transport.write(tunnelReq)
        self._protocolDataReceived = protocol.dataReceived
        protocol.dataReceived = self.processProxyResponse
        self._protocol = protocol
        return protocol
```
